title: Client Service Associate (Korean Speaking)
content:
CLIENT SERVICE ASSOCIATE (Korean speaking) -  Fresh Graduates & Expats Welcome

 

• Location: Hai Ba Trung street, Xuan Hoa (D.3), Ho Chi Minh city, Vietnam

• Working Hours: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM, Monday to Friday (8-hour shift + 1-hour break)

• Work Environment: International, Fully English-speaking

 

YOUR FIRST STEP INTO GLOBAL BUSINESS: BECOME A STRATEGIC KNOWLEDGE BROKER

 

Are you a fresh graduate, a young professional, or an expat looking to launch an international career in one of Southeast Asia’s most vibrant mega-cities?

 

 

At Dialectica, we don’t just offer a job; we offer a commercial bootcamp. As a Korean-speaking Associate, you will be the vital information bridge between global decision-makers and the world’s most specialized industry experts. You will partner with our elite clients, including top-tier investment banks, hedge funds, strategy consultancies, and Fortune 500 corporations, to understand their knowledge gaps. Your mission? Identify, headhunt, and persuade C-suite executives to share their insights in exclusive consultation interviews.

benefits_v2.description:
WHY JOIN US IN HO CHI MINH CITY?

 

  • Full Relocation & Visa Support: Smooth onboarding with corporate relocation assistance, flight & accommodation support, and full visa/work permit sponsorship for expats.
  • Top-Tier Compensation Package: A highly competitive base salary, monthly allowances, and an attractive uncapped monthly bonus scheme that stands out against market benchmarks.
  • Transparent Career Path: Fast-track promotion path designed for rapid growth. High performers can reach Manager level in 2 years and Vice President in 5 years.
  • Global Mobility: Opportunities to work in our other global offices (Athens, Montreal, or Bogota) through our international exchange program.
  • Comprehensive Benefits: 20 paid leaves per year, hybrid working policy, premium private medical insurance, wellness sponsorships, and frequent team-bonding events.
  • Skill Mastery: Master the "soft skills of the future": negotiation, strategic communication, B2B headhunting, and international project management.
  • Live in HCMC: Experience life in a dynamic, fast-paced, and culturally rich city with a thriving expat community, located right in the heart of Ho Chi Minh City.

responsibilities_original:
YOUR DAY-TO-DAY RESPONSIBILITIES

 

  • Deconstructing Briefs: Analyze complex client needs to identify knowledge gaps and determine the exact industry insights required.
  • High-Level Headhunting: Conduct deep profile research using LinkedIn and global professional networks to identify top-tier industry leaders.
  • Cold Outreach & Persuasion: Initiate conversations (via phone and email) to pitch projects and persuade global experts to participate in consultations.
  • End-to-End Project Management: Own the final step, from matching vetted experts with clients and coordinating schedules across international time zones, to ensuring every client interaction runs seamlessly.
requirements_original:
WHAT WE LOOK FOR (POTENTIAL OVER EXPERIENCE)

 

We value your drive, language skills, and potential over years on a resume. If you are a fresh graduate or an expat ready to pivot your career, we look for:

 

  • Multilingual Fluency: Fluency in Korean (TOPIK 5 / TOPIK 6 or native level) and fluent/business English is a must.
  • Sales & KPI Drive: A result-oriented mindset. Show us your hunger to achieve through previous internships, high-pressure university projects, or extracurricular achievements.
  • Resilience: A growth mindset that views cold outreach and rejections as opportunities to sharpen your negotiation skills.
  • Business Acumen: A bachelor’s degree in any discipline, backed by solid organization, rapid information processing, and problem-solving skills.
  • International Mindset: Adaptable, curious, and excited to work in a highly diverse, multicultural team.
